text: SELECT year(date) AS year, month(date) AS month, sum(position) AS total WHERE account ~ '^Income:' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
SELECT year(date) AS year, month(date) AS month, sum(position) AS total WHERE account ~ '^Expenses:' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
SELECT account, sum(position) AS balance GROUP BY account ORDER BY account
SELECT date, account, filename, lineno ORDER BY date, filename, lineno
